outputs.explanation: Lower graph shows mean ± SD and the panel image reports 'N=4 n>100', but the caption/panel do not explicitly state what the replicates represent (animals vs cells) as a clear replication type.
The caption explicitly states 'four ... mice' for the groups and the panel reports N=4 (and n>400), so number and replicate type (mice) are reported and n>2.
Panel C shows a representative Western blot without reported quantification or summary statistics; appears to be a representative image rather than replicated quantitative data.

Group Ns are reported in the figure (N=13, N=9, N=7, N=13) and the experiment is described in the caption as a test of mouse motor performance, so number and replicate type (mice) are reported and minimum n>2.
Panel E shows detailed rotarod data with group Ns reported; replicate type (mice) is indicated by the experimental context, and n for each group is >2.
Survival (Kaplan–Meier) plot includes group Ns in the figure legend; the experiment involves mice and reported group sizes are all >2.
Panel G displays histological images (representative images) without quantitative summary statistics; no replicated quantitative data are reported in the panel itself.
